patterns.note: Full-width sections with content often centered or aligned to a strong grid, frequently featuring large, full-bleed imagery that breaks the standard grid for visual impact.
Prominent, large, uppercase sans-serif headings are used for section titles, creating a strong visual hierarchy, often in high contrast black or white.
A high-contrast black and white base palette is consistently used, dramatically punctuated by a single, vibrant lime green/yellow accent color for CTAs and highlights.

Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, and the hero section features a background image that appears to parallax or remain fixed while foreground content scrolls over it.
Editorial-style content blocks are integrated throughout the page, combining large, artistic photography with concise text to tell a story or highlight features.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header navigation that remains visible at the top of the viewport, maintaining brand presence and accessibility.
Scroll-triggered animations, likely using CSS keyframes as detected, reveal content sections with a subtle fade-in or slide-up motion as they enter the user's view, enhancing engagement.
The hero section utilizes a large, full-bleed background image with a subtle parallax or fixed-background effect, allowing foreground text and subsequent content to scroll over it, creating depth.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold, often uppercase sans-serif headings (up to ~4-5x body text size) create a strong visual hierarchy, complemented by smaller, legible body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used across all elements, including buttons, images, and containers, contributing to a clean, modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within editorial blocks, while product grids maintain a tighter, consistent rhythm.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its stark, high-contrast black-and-white aesthetic, which is dramatically enlivened by a single, vibrant lime green accent color. This minimalist palette, combined with bold, almost brutalist typography and artistic, full-bleed product photography, creates an editorial and luxurious feel that elevates the brand beyond typical electronics e-commerce.
